prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1: edit target, an existing white-background CAD-style blue belt conveyor catalog illustration.
Primary request: Change ONLY the mounting position and orientation of the existing grey geared electric motor drive. Remove its current position out in front of the conveyor's RIGHT END. Mount the complete motor-and-gearbox assembly OUTBOARD ON THE NEAR LONG SIDE of the conveyor, at the RIGHT drive-drum end, next to the visible right-hand drum bearing. The drive should project toward the viewer from the long side, NOT extend beyond the conveyor's short end face. Place a mechanically plausible right-angle gearbox at the end of the drum shaft, coupled coaxially to the transverse drum axle through the side bearing; the motor body extends leftward along the near long side rail, parallel to the belt travel direction, supported on a compact blue side bracket. In the perspective shown, the relocated motor should appear in the foreground just LEFT of the near right-end drum bearing, OUTSIDE the blue long side beam. The drum shaft goes across the width of the belt; the gearbox connects to its outboard side end. One drive only. Do not leave another motor at the short end. Maintain visible separation between motor and black belt.
Invariants: keep the same conveyor length, black belt, blue frame, four support legs and feet, silver drums and return rollers, materials, colors, perspective, realistic catalog-render style and soft illumination. Keep the seamless PURE WHITE background and landscape 3:2 composition with full equipment visible and white margins. Do not add guards, cargo, text, labels, logos, watermark or background objects.
